sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Build, start and page checks
sections.what: Looks up the repository owner's account, builds the dev container with pinned tools, starts the dev server, waits for the home page, requests each main page and requires success, then prints the settings lines with values hidden.
sections.why: The header says it checks the Codespace setup and records the owner account id.
sections.watch_out: Pages are checked from a fixed list, so a new page is not tested until it is added to that list.

summary: CI check that builds the cloud workspace from scratch, starts the app and confirms the main pages load.
purpose: Catch broken workspace setup before someone opens the project.
why: The header says it checks the Codespace setup and records the repository owner's account id for the authorship check. Likely reason for pinned versions: repeatable results.
how: 1) Look up the repository owner's public account. 2) Check out the code. 3) Build the dev container with a pinned tool version, which runs the install and setup steps. 4) Start the dev server in the background. 5) Wait up to about four minutes for the home page. 6) Request each main page and require a 200 response. 7) Print the settings lines with values hidden.
inputs: The workspace setup files, the workflow token, and the repository owner's account.
outputs: Pass or fail, the status code for each page, and the tail of the log on failure.
risks: The page list is fixed, so new main pages are not checked until added. The lookup uses the workflow token to read account details.
debug: If a page does not return 200, the log tail shows why. If the build times out, check the setup script's steps. The owner lookup line shows the account id.
